info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Historic Transaction Insights API
info.description: The Historic Transaction Insights API enables businesses to access and analyze historic transaction data for a specific customer account. This API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive overview of past transactions, facilitating insights into customer behavior and financial trends. Typical consumers include financial analysts and customer service representatives, who use this data for reporting and customer inquiries. The endpoint supports the aggregation of transaction records, ensuring organizations can leverage historical data to enhance decision-making and customer engagement.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to record a historic transaction for a specified customer account. It is designed to enable businesses to maintain an accurate transaction history, which can be vital for auditing, compliance, and customer relationship management.

requestBody.description: Request body for posting historic transactions for a specific account. This operation allows you to submit transaction details which will be processed accordingly. Ensure all required fields are filled as per the defined schema.
